items.author: LesusX
items.text:
A customisable water shader for Godot 4 games! 
The code is available on GitHub: https://t.co/z9kLAWE8KP
I also made a short video if you want to check how to use it: https://t.co/Irw2SJepPZ https://t.co/baz4c3qsNi
items.readme_excerpt:
This project showcases a **Gerstner wave ocean shader** built in Godot 4.  
The shader simulates realistic ocean movement, caustics, foam, and depth-based color blending.

items.author: TokenGremlin
items.text_excerpt:
I’ve officially open-sourced ABYSSAL. 🌊⚡

ABYSSAL is a fully procedural ocean and extreme-weather experience that runs directly in the browser. Waves, volumetric clouds, rain, lightning, hurricanes, waterspouts, rogue waves, and tsunamis are generated in real time using Three.js, WebGL2, and GLSL.

items.readme_excerpt: Foam accumulates and decays over time from surface Jacobian and wave steepness, so whitecaps build where the sea is actually breaking rather than being painted on.
